videos.title: Claude Design exploder trick
summary: Futurepedia's latest short highlights a single-prompt workflow in Claude that the channel calls the "design exploder trick," using one instruction to generate six distinct visual design directions at once rather than iterating on one concept at a time.

The appeal of the technique is the side-by-side comparison it produces: instead of refining a single design idea through back-and-forth prompting, a creator can see six stylistically different options in one pass and pick a direction to develop further, speeding up early-stage concepting.

The clip fits Futurepedia's recurring short-form format of quick, practical Claude and ChatGPT tips aimed at non-technical creators and marketers looking for fast ways to fold AI tools into an existing design workflow.
